_about: Hand-run checks of each listing against the provider's own website home page, 2026-10-08. Read by scripts/gunnison_site/build_site_data.py. status: ok = site live, no closure sign, key details match; unknown = site live but stale or details could not be confirmed. fixes: fields the provider's own site states that the dataset lacked or had wrong (prototype only; belongs in the dataset's overrides). Only the home page was read, not sub-pages.
